description: Allowlist for railway-reference-guard.ts. Each entry permits a specific service.VARIABLE to hold a hardcoded connection-string literal instead of a ${{Producer.VAR}} reference. Every entry MUST document why the literal is legitimate. Keep this list minimal; the default expectation is that *_URL variables are references so a single rotation propagates to all consumers.

allow.reason: Runtime connection uses the custom no-DELETE 'fleet_app' role, which has its own password and is NOT the postgres superuser. Railway exposes no output variable for the fleet_app URL, so this must be a literal. The fleet_app password is rotated via a separate documented procedure. Migration credential (MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL) IS a reference: ${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}}.
Same as api.DATABASE_URL: fleet_app runtime role literal; no Railway output variable exists for it.
